title: Join two clips
description: Put one clip after another. Both are scaled to the size you choose (centered crop). The frame rate of the first clip is used for the whole clip, so a second clip with a different frame rate plays faster or slower (25 fps after 30 fps runs about 20% fast). The joined clip has no sound.
